summary: Iteration 7 — V3 P0 batch (role gate, Start-Session modal, primer caps, BESM blurbs, node revealed-to filter, Tri-Stat credit, Permissions-Policy header, Reference cards). Added 21 new pytest cases under TestIter7Roles (7), TestIter7PrimerCaps (3), TestIter7BesmBlurbs (7), TestIter7NodeVisibility (2), TestIter7PermissionsPolicy (2) — all 21 PASS. Full backend suite: 106/108 stable (98.1%); 2 failures are pre-existing carry-overs (TestCORS::test_preflight_preview_origin_ok empty-FRONTEND_URL wildcard short-circuit; TestRecap::test_recap_bullet_style LLM 429 rate-limit). The 3 WS failures in the first full run all PASS on rerun (transient network flakiness, not regressions). Frontend Playwright covered: (a) /auth?mode=register shows auth-role-picker with auth-role-player (default-selected, gold border) + auth-role-gm, helper text 'Players can switch to GM later from their profile'. (b) Player @ /app/campaigns: new-campaign-btn is HTML-disabled with text ' GMs only'. (c) Reference page (/app/reference): 20 ref-blurb-* cards rendered, ref-generic-blurbs section present, Attack Mastery shows 'Adds its Level to your Attack Combat Value...' blurb. (d) GM @ /app/campaigns/{cid}: tri-stat-credit visible with full Tri-Stat Emporium © notice referencing Mark MacKinnon & Dyskami. (e) start-session-btn opens start-session-modal (NOT browser prompt) with start-session-title input + start-session-confirm; clicking confirm creates session and navigates to /app/sessions/{newId}. (f) Player Primer tab: primer-caps section visible with primer-cap-min, primer-cap-max, primer-cap-attr-rank, primer-save-btn (and helper labels '0 = no floor', '0 = use Power Level default', '0 = no per-Attribute cap'). (g) Knowledge Web → Weave node opens NodeEditor; node-visibility selector has all 3 options ['gm_only — secret', 'shared — All players', 'revealed — Specific players']; selecting revealed reveals reveal-picker with member buttons (Fran, Player). All UI flows green; no console errors during testing.

minor.issue: (carry-over) FRONTEND_URL empty → allow_origins=['*'] short-circuits Starlette regex matcher; preflight reflects no origin. Fix in iter_3+; pass allow_origins=[] when wildcard desired so allow_origin_regex applies.
(carry-over) Returns 429/transient when LLM provider rate-limits; not a code bug.

Flaky on first run under load (3/108 transient timeouts on test_ws_public_campaign_any_member_connects, test_presence_room_then_join_propagates_two_clients, test_webrtc_offer_no_to_field_is_dropped); all 3 PASS on rerun. Consider raising _drain_until timeouts from 5s→8s and retrying once.

action_items: (Optional, carry-over) Fix CORS preflight when FRONTEND_URL is empty by passing allow_origins=[] so allow_origin_regex applies.
(Optional, carry-over) Add per-(session,user) cooldown / 502-body sanitisation in generate_recap so LLM 429s don't bubble up as opaque 5xx in the integration test.
(Optional) Stabilise WS-presence pytest cases by raising _drain_until budget or adding a 1-shot retry decorator — currently 3 of them flake under cluster load.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1543 lines — the role-gate (line 704), Permissions-Policy middleware (line 102), startup migration (line 411), and BESM enrichment (lines 548-572) are scattered. Strongly recommend splitting into auth.py / besm.py / middleware.py modules; the file has crossed 1500-line threshold flagged in iter_6 critical review.

RegisterIn.role uses Literal['player','gm'] — admin role can only be promoted via DB or seed; consider an explicit /api/admin/users/{id}/role endpoint guarded by admin so GM↔player role changes don't require DB surgery.

create_campaign role-gate (server.py:704) only checks role=='player' → returns 403. If a future role like 'observer' is added, it would bypass the gate. Safer pattern: if user.get('role') not in ('gm','admin'): raise 403.

/api/besm/reference is a hot endpoint (called on every Reference / CharacterBuilder mount) and now does 5 list comprehensions with dict spread. Cache the response in-process (functools.lru_cache or module-level dict) — payload is fully static.

GENERIC_BLURBS is a dict but downstream needs ordering ('How costing works' first); Python 3.7+ preserves insertion order so this is fine, but worth a code comment so a future contributor doesn't switch to a sorted/json-serialised store and break the UI ordering.

Frontend CharacterBuilder cap-clamp (per spec) clamps level on submit — also enforce on input change to give immediate UX feedback (the 'attr-overcap-N' message exists; the input itself should set max={effectiveMaxRank}).

AVSeats iframe-detection runs window.top !== window.self once at mount; if the app is later embedded dynamically (e.g., a popup wrapper) the banner won't appear. Move detection into a useEffect that re-checks on visibilitychange — minor.
